item.title: Patch: Multiple Vulnerabilities Affecting IBM Langflow
item.description:
Langflow (multiple products): CCB warning · fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for the affected Langflow products. The CCB advisory lists the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

High · Fix available
